name: claude-budget-advisor
description: Tracks Claude Code project token pacing and monthly budget health, and runs a local optimizing proxy that prunes outgoing Anthropic Messages API traffic.

commands.title: Claude Token Improver: Copy Proxy Base URL
Claude Token Improver: Open Telemetry Ledger

claudeBudgetAdvisor.enabled.description: Show budget pacing in the status bar and dashboard.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.scope.description: Count usage from all Claude projects, or only the project of the open workspace.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.budget.description: Monthly token budget. 0 infers it from your usage history.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.projectName.description: Optional. Only used when scope is 'project'. Leave empty to detect it from the workspace folder.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.baseDir.description: Folder where Claude Code stores its sessions (read for monthly usage). Empty detects it from CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, your home folder or the claude CLI.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.spendSource.description: Where spend figures come from. 'auto' calls the Admin API when ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY is set, otherwise uses the local estimate. 'mock' previews the layout with sample data.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.spendLimitFile.description: Optional path to a JSON payload from the spend limits endpoint. When set, its totals replace the local estimate.

claudeBudgetAdvisor.refreshIntervalMinut.description: Minutes between automatic refreshes of the budget and dashboard. 0 disables them. It also refreshes after each completed turn, at most once a minute.

claudeTokenImprover.autoStart.description: Start the proxy when the extension activates.

claudeTokenImprover.autoConfigureTermina.description: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in new VS Code terminals so Claude Code goes through the proxy. Terminals already open must be reopened.

claudeTokenImprover.port.description: Local port the proxy listens on (127.0.0.1 only).

claudeTokenImprover.upstreamBaseUrl.description: Server the proxy forwards requests to. Change only for a gateway or test server.

claudeTokenImprover.stage1Normalization.description: Stage 1. Trim whitespace and normalize line endings so cache prefixes match byte for byte.

claudeTokenImprover.stage2Compaction.description: Stage 2. Remove greeting filler and, past the sliding threshold, replace the oldest history with a summary the proxy builds itself from the conversation (what was asked and answered, files touched, commands run). No model is called and it costs no tokens.

claudeTokenImprover.stage3ModelRouting.description: Stage 3. Send short, mechanical turns to Haiku instead of the requested model.

claudeTokenImprover.stage4CacheAnchor.description: Stage 4. Keep a single cache anchor on the last assistant turn; system and tools breakpoints are untouched.

enumDescriptions: Writes cost 1.25x. A keep-alive ping every ~4.5 minutes renews the cache for up to 30 minutes after your last request (setting keepAliveMaxMinutes), so it does not expire during normal pauses.
Writes cost 2x; the cache lasts 1 hour.
claudeTokenImprover.cacheTtl.description: Cache lifetime the proxy sets on every request. 1 h costs more per write but survives longer pauses.

claudeTokenImprover.startupSonnetDefault.description: Stage 0. If the first request after the proxy starts is Opus, send it to Sonnet. Later requests and models chosen with /model are not changed.

claudeTokenImprover.slidingThresholdToke.description: History size, in tokens, that triggers a summary.

claudeTokenImprover.warmCacheCompactionT.description: History size, in tokens, from which a summary is made even while the cache is warm (for example kept warm by the keep-alive), if the estimate says it pays for the cache rewrite. 0 turns it off.

claudeTokenImprover.compactionFraction.description: The newest (1 - value) x threshold tokens of history stay verbatim; everything older is summarized. At 0.75 with a 15,000 threshold, the newest ~3,750 tokens are kept.

claudeTokenImprover.expectedRequestsAfte.description: Requests expected after a summary, used to decide if it pays for itself. A summary is skipped when its expected saving is below the cache rewrite.

claudeTokenImprover.agentSummary.description: Write the summary of old history with a short `claude -p` run (Haiku, from a neutral folder, in chunks under 100K tokens). It uses a little of your Claude Code quota; if it fails the proxy builds a local summary instead. Off: always local.

claudeTokenImprover.exactTokenCounting.description: Measure the size before optimization with Anthropic's count_tokens instead of a local estimate. More exact, but adds one call per turn.

claudeTokenImprover.keepAliveMaxMinutes.description: Keep the prompt cache warm with a one-token ping every ~4.5 min, until this many minutes after your last request (30 by default, 0 = off). Each ping costs one cache read of the prefix; it pays off for pauses under ~30 min. Measured on the October ledger: best around 30. On a subscription plan every ping counts against your usage limit.

claudeTokenImprover.pricingUrl.description: Model price feed (LiteLLM JSON). Change only to use a mirror.
